about.title: About CareLeap
about.body: CareLeap shows how clinic appointment hours line up with bus service, so clinics can pick hours that more car-less patients can actually reach. Logistics only. Your care team decides your care.
about.guardrail: Every number carries a source and vintage. Patients shown are synthetic.
